title: Find every mention of the state-home variable before it is renamed
prompt:
The environment variable that points TerminalX at its state folder, `RACCOON_HOME`, is being renamed to `TERMINALX_HOME`. For a compatibility period the old name will still be read when the new one is unset, and that will be documented. Before anyone edits, audit the repository: find every tracked file whose text uses `RACCOON_HOME` (Rust code, comments, contributor and user documentation, guides) and so has to be updated for the rename.

Write the answer to `bench-answer.txt` at the repository root: one repository-relative path per line (for example `path/to/file.rs`), each file once, nothing else on the line. List files, not line numbers. Do not change any other file.
notes: Large (23 files), repository-wide: Rust under src-tauri/src plus top-level and docs/ Markdown.
